title: Versatile Strategy for the Construction of a Transcription Factor-Based Orthogonal Gene Expression Toolbox in Monascus spp.
authors: Duan, Yali; Tan, Yingao; Wei, Xuetuan; Pei, Xiaolin; Li, Mu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子模拟和定点突变改造转录因子MaR的DNA结合残基，构建正交基因表达工具箱，虽涉及TF-DNA互作建模，但核心是合成生物学应用而非机制研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合预测。
abstract: Gene expression is needed to be conducted in an orthogonal manner and controllable independently from the host's native regulatory system. However, there is a shortage of gene expression regulatory toolboxes that function orthogonally from each other and toward the host. Herein, we developed a strategy based on the mutant library to generate orthogonal gene expression toolboxes. A transcription factor, MaR, located in the Monascus azaphilone biosynthetic gene cluster, was taken as a typical example. Nine DNA-binding residues of MaR were identified by molecular simulation and site-directed mutagenesis. We created five MaR multi-site saturation mutagenesis libraries consisting of 10743 MaR variants on the basis of five cognate promoters. A functional analysis revealed that all five tested promoters were orthogonally regulated by five different MaR variants, respectively. Furthermore, fine gene expression tunability and high signal sensitivity of this toolbox are demonstrated by introducing chemically inducible expression modules, designing synthetic promoter elements, and creating protein-protein interaction between MaRs. This study paves the way for a bottom-up approach to build orthogonal gene expression toolboxes.
abstract_zh: 基因表达需要以正交方式进行，并独立于宿主的天然调控系统进行可控调节。然而，目前缺乏能够彼此正交且对宿主正交发挥作用的基因表达调控工具箱。在此，我们开发了一种基于突变体库的策略，以生成正交基因表达工具箱。以红曲菌中azaphilone生物合成基因簇中的转录因子MaR作为典型示例。通过分子模拟和定点突变，鉴定了MaR的九个DNA结合残基。我们基于五个同源启动子，构建了五个MaR多位点饱和突变体库，包含10743个MaR变体。功能分析表明，所有五个测试的启动子分别由五个不同的MaR变体正交调控。此外，通过引入化学诱导表达模块、设计合成启动子元件以及创建MaR之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，证明了该工具箱具有精细的基因表达可调性和高信号灵敏度。本研究为自下而上构建正交基因表达工具箱铺平了道路。
